name: obd2-mcp
description: MCP server that lets AI assistants read your car's OBD-II data through ELM327 adapters — trouble codes, live sensors, freeze frame, readiness monitors, VIN. Ships with a mock vehicle so you can try it without any hardware.

scripts.demo:ja: npm run build && node dist/index.js --demo --summary --lang ja
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/adapter.mjs test/cli.mjs test/connection.mjs test/transport.mjs test/dtc.mjs test/code-info.mjs test/hints.mjs test/permanent-dtcs.mjs test/pids.mjs test/safety.mjs test/scenarios.mjs test/demo.mjs test/diagnostic-report.mjs test/compare.mjs test/report-text.mjs test/ecu-info.mjs test/battery-voltage.mjs test/reconnect.mjs test/history.mjs test/supported-pids.mjs test/watch-live-data.mjs test/ports.mjs test/prompts.mjs test/resources.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs

author: Sho Kamakura (https://github.com/shoka-jp)
